SessionStart matcher=startup|resume #9c2: Hands the work to a detached child and exits 0 at once. The child moves the claude-settings local main to origin/main by fast-forward only (in a clean tree that holds main, or by ref), then runs merge/install_from_main.sh from the clone only when the live pin is not at main. It never stashes, resets or forces in your trees; install_from_main.sh switches only the pin, and never one with tracked changes. Does nothing in cloud sessions. A failed fetch, move or tracked-change skip writes one line to the install log, with git's own reason.
